tasks.final_text: Today I went to lunch at a new suchi place in Dallas Texas. I hadn't been there before and was there with a colleagure. We didn't know what was good or what to order so we relied on the waiter to make recommendations. They were perfect and we had a good meal.

Shopper's World is an open-air shopping center in Framingham, Massachusetts. the original facility (spelled Shoppers' World) is of historical significance as one of the first subraban shopping malls in the United State upon opening in 1951; thoug hit had a central courtyard and covered walkways, it was not fully indoor.
